builds.name: Kingslayer ceiling
builds.summary: Kingslayer max heal is 2*(100+.3 AP+.05 bonus HP) at <=40% HP. AP, heal power and Spirit Visage amplify self recovery; replace ally-only Staff.
builds.goal: Kingslayer max heal is 2*(100+.3 AP+.05 bonus HP) at <=40% HP. AP, heal power and Spirit Visage amplify self recovery; replace ally-only Staff.
builds.hypothesis:
Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing [75 / 110 / 145 / 180 / 215 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between [20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and [(20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (2)] Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below [40]% Health).
Deathcap supplies multiplicative AP; Dawncore converts the support items base mana regen into AP/heal power; Redemption/Mikael/Ardent/Staff supply heal power, with actives excluded. Aery/Revitalize favor eligible protection; Gathering Storm fixed to 30min raises AP; Manaflow is only useful on mana users.

First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

builds.name: Abduct: one AP chain collision

builds.goal: Investigate high one Abduct chain hit output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The E recast deals 80/130/180/230/280 + 0.8 AP magic to the first enemy hit. The opening dash enables the recast but does not supply another full damaging E packet. Petricite Burst attacks are separate effects.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3.5s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; no free permanent stacks. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Seraph legally transformed. Opening dash legally used, followed by one chain within its 3.5-second recast window. The scored champion is the first enemy hit; no minion or other enemy blocks the chain. No passive attacks or stolen ultimate included.
